topic: 65,3% de mães negras revelam que não conseguem entrar no setor audiovisual, diz pesquisa do Grupo Nexa Cine Notícia Preta Brasil
insights: 65.3% of Black mothers report difficulty entering the audiovisual sector.
68.3% of Black mothers express a desire to start a career in the audiovisual industry.
The research involved 646 Black mothers from various regions of Brazil.
52.5% of the mothers have one child, while 27.9% have two children.
55.1% of the respondents are concentrated in the Southeast region of Brazil.

summary: A recent study by Grupo Nexa Cine reveals that a significant majority of Black mothers in Brazil face barriers to entering the audiovisual sector, despite a strong desire to do so. The findings highlight the need for supportive policies that address the unique challenges faced by this demographic.
